device.name: the prediction, drawn ahead of the event and subtracted by it
device.implementation: three copies of one path — ghost (teal, 30px), real (ink, 15px), cancel (paper, 40px) — revealed to p, q and matched?min(p,q):0. Paint order is the arithmetic.

audio.music: a single held low fifth that opens a fourth when the mechanism is named; nothing licensed or sampled
audio.sfx: every touch is a synthesised brush of filtered noise; every prediction is that same waveform INVERTED at the instant the forward model says the touch will land, and the mixer adds them

brand.logo: InkBrand.mark(), play triangle in this film's teal #0F7B6C

delivery_encode.shipped: CRF 20, muxed in the same pass

providers_used: none — zero API keys, zero generated images, zero stock, zero licensed audio
